svg.text: 568-70.9001 sheet 4 (redrawn): lighting, main contactors, motor and cut-clutch contactors, time relays
(10) cut-line indication E3, E4 (NÁZNAK ŘEZU E3,E4)
(11) main contactors KM1A, KM1B (HLAVNÍ STYKAČE KM1A,KM1B)
(13) contactors of the knife and hydraulics drive motor KM2, KM3, KM4
(STYKAČE MOTORU PRO POHON NOŽE A HYDRAULIKY KM2,KM3,KM4)
(15) time relay: cut delay after clamping
KT2 (ČASOVÉ RELÉ ZPOŽDĚNÍ ŘEZU ZA LISOVÁNÍM

- KT1 contacts: NO or NC is not readable on the print; by the face legend of the maker (photo 20261102_144259, IEC numbering 15-16-18, 25-26-28) 4-5 = 15-18 is NO (star KM4) and 12-14 = 25-26 is NC (delta KM3); KT1 9-10 (B1-B2) is bridged by KM2 62-61 (NC). Dial setting not read (on-site).
- RC8 across the KM8 coil: label read as RC8 or RC6 [?].
- BMR1 19-20 (an output of the cut-control module, sheet 7) opens the main-contactor chain; drawn as printed: a NO contact with the reference (7:01).
- Q2 contacts are drawn open as printed (1-2, 3-4 closed in position 0; 9-10 closed in position 1).
- ink: pencil "ZN" (KT1) and "ZR" (KT2) at the contact lists of the clean copy of this sheet (20261113_233009): handwriting, not print.
- Which wire lands first on a shared terminal is not printed; lines follow the netlist rows.
- Under each coil, below the coil-return bus to X5: its contact list as printed, the (sheet:column) of each of its contacts; NO left and NC right where the print splits them.
Devices on this sheet (from control_devices.csv; [?] = unclear, estimated = with likely error)
UG50 [sure] rectified and AC control supplies +27V +24V +33V ~24V ~48V (PLOŠNÝ SPOJ SE ZDROJI UG50); terminals 1-32; place: cabinet; device row: sheet 3, column 03-04
QF1 [sure] M1 protection; aux 43-44 in the control chain; aux contact 43-44 NO used at 4:10; place: cabinet; device row: sheet 2, column 07-10
X10 [sure] terminal strip in the cabinet (1-6 to M1) (SVORKOVNICE V ROZVADĚČI); 45 terminals + 3 PE (photo); place: cabinet; device row: sheet 2, column 04-09
X5 [sure] working-earth strip: 0 V of all control supplies, bonded to PE (SVORKOVNICE PRAC. ZEMĚ); terminal numbers not printed; place: cabinet; device row: sheet 2, column 02
S2 [sure] work lighting / cut-line indication selector (PŘEPÍNAČ OSVĚTLENÍ – NÁZNAK ŘEZU; RU выключатель освещения и назначения реза); contacts 3A-4A (work light), 4B-3B (cut line); OM
list 10.1: BACO head V22MA03, adapter 233E, block 23E10; place: cabinet; device row: sheet 4, column 02-05
E1 [sure] work-surface lighting lamp (OSVĚTLENÍ PRACOVNÍ PLOCHY E1, E2); ~24 V AC; place: machine; device row: sheet 4, column 01
E2 [sure] work-surface lighting lamp (OSVĚTLENÍ PRACOVNÍ PLOCHY E1, E2); ~24 V AC; place: machine; device row: sheet 4, column 02
E3 [sure] cut-line indication lamp (NÁZNAK ŘEZU E3, E4); ~24 V AC; place: machine; device row: sheet 4, column 03-05
E4 [sure] cut-line indication lamp (NÁZNAK ŘEZU E3, E4); ~24 V AC; place: machine; device row: sheet 4, column 03-05
BMR1 [sure] cut-control module: two-hand start, knife lock, clutch contactors, cut-done signal (MODUL ŘÍZENÍ ŘEZU (PŘIPOJENÍ MODULU ŘÍZENÍ ŘEZU BMR1); RU релейный модуль управления
реза); one relay board, plate "BMR2" (photo 143021), maker not printed or seen; terminals 1-29, 0V (-), +24V (+); OM list 10.2 "BMR.." 900 010 0714; place: cabinet; device row: sheet
S5 [sure] belt-pulley cover interlock (KONCOVÝ SPÍNAČ – BLOKOVÁNÍ KRYTU ŘEMENICE; red ink on sheet 1 "у маховика" (at the flywheel)); NC 21-22 (4:10), NO 13-14 (5:09); place: machine;
S1 [sure] emergency stop switch (only MS 115 PS, DS) (SPÍNAČ NOUZOVÉHO ZASTAVENÍ; "POUZE MS115" printed at 4:10); NC 21-22; OM list 10.1: BACO V22E01 + 231E + 23E01; place: console;
KM1A [sure] main contactor (in series with KM1B) (HLAVNÍ STYKAČE KM1A, KM1B); coil 24 V AC 50 Hz; place: cabinet; device row: sheet 4, column 09
KM1B [sure] main contactor (in series with KM1A) (HLAVNÍ STYKAČE KM1A, KM1B); coil 24 V AC 50 Hz; place: cabinet; device row: sheet 4, column 11
Q2 [sure] M1 run switch; contacts 1-2..7-8 closed in 0, 9-10 closed in 1; photo: 16 A 660 V AC, IEC 947-3; place: cabinet; device row: sheet 4-6, column 08; 17; 16; 09; 14-15
RC1 [sure] coil suppressor across KM1A and KM1B; 2µ2 + 220R (sheet-box 4); place: cabinet; device row: sheet 4, column 10
S4 [sure] air-cushion blower motor switch (energises KM8) (SPÍNAČ MOTORU VZDUCHOVÉHO POLŠTÁŘE); contact 3-4 (latching symbol); OM list 10.1: BACO head V22KA03, adapter 231E, block
23E10; place: cabinet; device row: sheet 4, column 12
KM8 [sure] blower (air cushion) motor contactor (STYKAČ MOTORU DMYCHADLA KM8); coil 50 Hz; place: cabinet; device row: sheet 4, column 12
RC8 [?] coil suppressor across KM8; 2µ2 + 220R (sheet-box 4); place: cabinet; device row: sheet 4, column 12
KM2 [sure] M1 line contactor (U2 V2 W2) (STYKAČE MOTORU PRO POHON NOŽE A HYDRAULIKY KM2, KM3, KM4); coil 50 Hz; place: cabinet; device row: sheet 4, column 13
RC2 [sure] coil suppressor across KM2; 2µ2 + 220R (sheet-box 4); place: cabinet; device row: sheet 4, column 13
KM3 [sure] M1 delta contactor (V1 W1 U1) (STYKAČE MOTORU PRO POHON NOŽE A HYDRAULIKY KM2, KM3, KM4); coil 50 Hz; place: cabinet; device row: sheet 4, column 14
RC3 [sure] coil suppressor across KM3; 2µ2 + 220R (sheet-box 4); place: cabinet; device row: sheet 4, column 14
KM4 [sure] M1 star contactor (shorts X10 4-5-6) (STYKAČE MOTORU PRO POHON NOŽE A HYDRAULIKY KM2, KM3, KM4); coil 50 Hz; place: cabinet; device row: sheet 4, column 15
RC4 [sure] coil suppressor across KM4; 2µ2 + 220R (sheet-box 4); place: cabinet; device row: sheet 4, column 15

dial 4-10, range x, s/min, setting not read; terminal face 4(15) 6(16) 5(18), 12(25) 14(26) 13(28), 1(A1) 2(A2) 3(A3), 10(B1) 9(B2); place: cabinet; device row: sheet 4, column 16
KM6 [sure] cut clutch contactor (STYKAČE SPOJKY ŘEZU KM6, KM7); coil 50 Hz; place: cabinet; device row: sheet 4, column 17
RC6 [sure] coil suppressor across KM6; 2µ2 + 220R (sheet-box 4); place: cabinet; device row: sheet 4, column 17
KM7 [sure] cut clutch contactor (STYKAČE SPOJKY ŘEZU KM6, KM7); coil 50 Hz; place: cabinet; device row: sheet 4, column 19
RC7 [sure] coil suppressor across KM7; 2µ2 + 220R (sheet-box 4); place: cabinet; device row: sheet 4, column 19
KT2 [sure] cut delay after clamping (delays KM7) (ČASOVÉ RELÉ ZPOŽDĚNÍ ŘEZU ZA LISOVÁNÍM KT2; RU временное реле опоздания реза за прижимом); OM list 10.2: TX 320 ZR, 24 V DC, 0-2,5 s
(p.49); OM p.7 and p.9: 0-3 s (conflict); photo: letters ZR, LED U, dial 4-10, s/min, setting not read; place: cabinet; device row: sheet 4, column 20
V20 [sure] free-wheel diode across the KT2 coil; 1N 4002 (sheet-box 4); place: cabinet; device row: sheet 4, column 20
- Adast Maxima MS 115 PS (serial 578.0009, 1998), control circuits: lighting, main contactors KM1A/KM1B, blower KM8, M1 star-delta KM2-KM4 with KT1, clutch contactors KM6/KM7, KT2.
- Redrawn from the wiring set 568-70.9001 SCHEMA ZAPOJENÍ (MS 80 PS,DS MS 115 PS,DS), sheet 4; columns and zones as printed.

- Marks: dashed line or [?] = unclear (on-site check list, spec/control.md); contacts in the off state as printed; end names 1/2 of lamps, RC parts and diodes are this redraw's names (1 = feed end, 2 = return end).
